items.guidance: Check the Express routes for an existing health or status route first. If you add one, register the GET /health handler in the app setup before the routers, passport or other auth, and any custom-domain redirect, and do not check Kafka, Redis, or the database inside it.

Find the Bull queue definitions and the code that calls process on them, and check whether the file that npm start runs loads them or whether a separate file starts them. Report the exact command of any separate worker file. Also report the Redis settings that Bull reads, because the facts list no Redis that Deployz provides.

Search for kafkajs imports and check whether the producer or consumer is created on the server start path or only when KAFKA_BROKERS or a feature setting is present. Report the files that create the Kafka client, whether startup fails without KAFKA_BROKERS, and any setting that switches the integration off, with its value.
